data_role: failed-H03 development trace; not held-out confirmation
formal_case: H03 algorithm seed 11 A0 historical trace, downsampled to the purchased detector's 1 Hz output contract
allowed_inputs: FKT-AQI-L 1 Hz and T90<=15 s device constraints

fixed_parameters.tau_grid_origin: hardware only: one-second output and T90<=15 s; first-order T90=tau*ln(10)
fixed_parameters.ordinal_feature: average-tie empirical ranks normalized by samples in each window
fixed_parameters.sensor_nuisance: profile minimum ordinal loss over the fixed tau grid for each joint source-timescale hypothesis

primary_gate_all_required: TAORL true-source rank strictly beats raw profiled-value arm
TAORL true-source rank strictly beats ICRA 2026 global EDF arm
TAORL true-source rank strictly beats reverse-time control
TAORL MAP error is below the historical native-PMFS endpoint error of 8.58 m
stop_rule: Any failed primary check stops TAORL tuning, PMFS integration, new seeds and cross-House execution.
claim_if_pass: H03 development premise only: hardware-bounded forward sensor time and local ordinal comparison add source-specific evidence before Bayesian accumulation.
